description: Permanently deletes a ticket in Zendesk, including its entire conversation history. This action is irreversible; always confirm the correct ticket_id before executing.

ticket_id.description: ID of the ticket to delete
ticket_id.human_parameter_description: The numeric ID of the Zendesk ticket you want to delete so we know exactly which ticket to remove. You can find this in the ticket's URL or from a ticket list.
ticket_id.title: Ticket Id

name: delete_zendesk_ticket

success.description: Indicates whether the ticket deletion was successful
success.title: Success
